title: From Prose to Properties: Testing Research Claims with ARATest for Agent-Native Science
title_zh: 从散文到性质：用ARATest面向智能体原生科学检验研究断言

paragraphs.en: Over the past two decades, high-level languages and open-source libraries made writing a program cheap, so the bottleneck shifted from producing software to establishing that it is correct [ 27 ] . AI agents now bring the same shift to research, the other half of the research and development cycle. They design experiments, run them, and report results [ 17 , 21 , 1 ] , and even use those results to improve themselves [ 15 , 13 ] . [ 37 ] reported 3.1 agent-workdays of runtime for every workday of human research labor, and venue submissions keep growing [ 25 ] . Once producing a result stops being the bottleneck, deciding which results justify the next step becomes one. That decision requires validating each claim against its evidence. But a claim states the property it implies only in prose, so automated validation falls to LLM judges that read the prose [ 55 ] . This check is unsound and scales poorly: LLM judges are slow and costly, and the same evidence can pass on one run and fail on the next [ 46 , 42 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 过去二十年间，高级语言和开源库使得编写程序变得廉价，因此瓶颈从生产软件转移到了证明软件正确 [ 27 ] 。 如今 AI 智能体将同样的转变带到了研发周期中另一半的工作——研究。 智能体设计实验、运行实验并报告结果 [ 17 , 21 , 1 ] ，甚至利用这些结果来改进自身 [ 15 , 13 ] 。 [ 37 ] 报告称，每一人类研究工作日对应 3.1 个智能体工作日的运行时间，而且会议投稿量持续增长 [ 25 ] 。 一旦产出结果不再是瓶颈，决定哪些结果值得推进下一步就成了新的瓶颈。 这项决策需要将每一条论断与其证据进行核对验证。 但论断仅以散文式的文字表述其所蕴含的性质，因此自动化验证只能依靠阅读这些文字的 LLM 评判器 [ 55 ] 。 这种检验既不可靠也难以扩展：LLM 评判器既慢又昂贵，而且同一份证据可能这次通过、下次失败 [ 46 , 42 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Software analysis scales because it checks a program against an explicit representation of what the program should do, kept apart from the program itself. Abstract interpretation checks a program through an abstraction of its semantics [ 10 ] , and testing checks it on concrete executions against a stated property. Property-based testing (PBT) separates the two concerns: a property states what must hold, and a generator supplies the cases [ 9 ] . A research claim keeps its property inside its prose, with no separate representation. To give claims that representation, we approximate the semantics of research claims by extracting their abstract properties , the relations a claim asserts independent of the evidence that instantiates them. We give these properties typed, executable specifications that a PBT framework can check.
paragraphs.zh: 软件分析之所以能够规模化，是因为它将程序与程序应当做什么的显式表示进行核对，而这一表示与程序本身是分离的。 抽象解释通过对程序语义的抽象来检查程序 [ 10 ] ，而测试则依据给定的性质在具体执行上对程序进行检查。 基于性质的测试（PBT）将这两个关注点分开：性质陈述必须成立的内容，而生成器提供测试用例 [ 9 ] 。 研究论断将其性质保留在自己的行文中，没有单独的表示。 为了给论断提供这种表示，我们通过提取研究论断的抽象性质来近似其语义，抽象性质是论断所断言的关系，独立于将其实例化的证据。 我们为这些性质提供带类型的可执行规范，供 PBT 框架进行检验。

paragraphs.en: An abstract property is useful only if it says exactly what the claim says. In LCA-on-the-Line [ 43 ] , one claim states that in-distribution LCA distance predicts out-of-distribution accuracy more strongly than Top-1 accuracy on four named shifted datasets. The reported correlations support the comparison on all four but reverse on ImageNet-v2, which the claim explicitly excludes ( Table 1 ). A property that quantified over every dataset in the table would call the claim false, while a property that ignored the dataset list could not tell a boundary from a counterexample. A reusable test must therefore pin down both the comparison and the scope of observations that can decide its verdict. Without such a test, each new assessment of the claim can answer a different question.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当抽象属性确切说明了该论断所陈述的内容时，它才有用。 在 LCA-on-the-Line [ 43 ] 中，一条论断指出：在四个具名偏移数据集上，分布内 LCA 距离对分布外准确率的预测能力强于 Top-1 准确率。 所报告的相关性支持全部四个数据集上的这一比较，但在 ImageNet-v2 上出现反转，而该论断明确排除了此数据集（ 表 1 ）。 若对表中每个数据集都进行量化的属性会判定该论断为假，而忽略数据集列表的属性则无法区分边界情况与反例。 因此，一个可复用的测试必须同时精确界定该比较本身，以及能够判定其结论的观测范围。 缺少这样的测试，对该论断的每次新评估就可能回答不同的问题。

paragraphs.en: We present ARATest , a PBT library that turns the abstract properties of research claims into reusable executable tests. ARATest provides abstract properties as property skeletons , parameterized relations that recur across claims. Skeletons build on property-specification patterns [ 14 ] and on recent property templates for testing and proof [ 38 , 32 ] . For each claim, a declaration binds a skeleton to a contract that fixes the compared quantities, quantified cases, admissible scope, and numerical policy ( Section 3.1 ). In a typed declaration, Kind selects a skeleton and Domain fills that skeleton’s parameters. In our design, the research agent writes this declaration while it does the research and records it with the claim in its agent-native research artifact (ARA) [ 33 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 ARATest，这是一个 PBT 库，它将研究论断的抽象性质转化为可复用的可执行测试。 ARATest 以性质骨架的形式提供抽象性质，即在各论断中反复出现的参数化关系。 骨架建立在性质规约模式 [ 14 ] 以及近期用于测试与证明的性质模板 [ 38 , 32 ] 的基础之上。 对于每条论断，一个声明将骨架绑定到一个契约，该契约固定了被比较的量、量化的情形、允许的范围以及数值策略（第 3.1 节）。 在类型化声明中，Kind 选择一个骨架，Domain 填充该骨架的参数。 在我们的设计中，研究智能体在进行研究的同时撰写此声明，并将其连同论断一起记录在其面向智能体的研究工件（ARA）[ 33 ] 中。

sents.zh: 我们提出 ARATest，这是一个 PBT 库，它将研究论断的抽象性质转化为可复用的可执行测试。

sents.zh: 在类型化声明中，Kind 选择一个骨架，Domain 填充该骨架的参数。

sents.en: In our design, the research agent writes this declaration while it does the research and records it with the claim in its agent-native research artifact (ARA) [ 33 ] .
sents.zh: 在我们的设计中，研究智能体在进行研究的同时撰写此声明，并将其连同论断一起记录在其面向智能体的研究工件（ARA）[ 33 ] 中。

paragraphs.en: ARATest keeps the property fixed and lets generators supply cases. Its default generator reads reported evidence from the ARA, which links claims to their evidence. Its auto-research generators draw fresh cases from experiment families that the research agent binds to a claim when it states the claim. For each such generator, ARATest dispatches an experiment-generator agent that runs the family’s experiments on released code. ARATest defines only the interface between generator and agent, so any agent that returns cases of the property’s type can serve. Our DissClaimer plugin supplies one such agent, built on OpenHands [ 49 ] , and a service that runs these generators as continuous testing campaigns under a budget. Because the agent’s run may not test the claim faithfully, ARATest treats a failing case on this path as feedback, not a refutation ( Section 3.5 ). Each property and its generators share a case type, such as a pair of table cells or a batch of seeded runs. Every generator therefore supplies cases in the claim’s statistical unit. We define a three-valued verdict semantics ( Section 3.6 ). We show that a violation’s witness alone suffices to replay the violation, while a pass corroborates only the cases checked. ARATest reports a violation as a warning, and its user decides whether the violation reveals a defect.
paragraphs.zh: ARATest 固定属性不变，让生成器提供测试用例。 其默认生成器从 ARA 读取已报告的证据，ARA 将断言与其证据关联起来。 其自动研究生成器从实验族中提取新鲜用例，研究智能体在陈述断言时将该实验族绑定到该断言。 对于每个此类生成器，ARATest 会派发一个实验生成器智能体，在已发布的代码上运行该实验族的实验。 ARATest 只定义生成器与智能体之间的接口，因此任何返回该属性类型用例的智能体都可以胜任。 我们的 DissClaimer 插件提供一个这样的智能体，它构建于 OpenHands [49] 之上，并提供一项服务，在预算内将这些生成器作为持续测试活动来运行。 由于该智能体的运行可能无法忠实地测试断言，ARATest 将此路径上的失败用例视为反馈，而非反驳（第 3.5 节）。 每个属性及其生成器共享一个用例类型，例如一对表格单元格或一批带种子的运行。 因此，每个生成器都以该断言的统计单位提供用例。 我们定义了三值判定语义（第 3.6 节）。 我们证明，仅凭违例的见证就足以重放该违例，而通过只能佐证所检查的用例。 ARATest 将违例报告为警告，由用户决定该违例是否揭示了一个缺陷。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ARATest on the compiled ARA artifacts of the ARA-PaperBench corpus [ 33 , 45 ] , which includes our MMD-FUSE [ 5 ] artifact, and on one more artifact for Simformer [ 18 ] . We compiled the MMD-FUSE and Simformer artifacts with the compiler skill from each paper and its released code ( Section 5 ). Of the 243 claims in 33 existing artifacts, 55 received a declaration that passed fidelity review, and 54 fully bound to reported evidence (22.2%). ARATest decided 40 claims (16.5%): 32 held and eight contradicted their mapped evidence. Excluding five decisions that check only reported summaries leaves 35 (14.4%). A source triage traced two violations to errors in published papers; we found no prior report of either, and the authors of both papers confirmed them. In each, a sentence states numbers that the paper’s own table contradicts. Four violations instead came from the compiled artifact. Fourteen bound claims remain inconclusive. The other 189 claims lack complete binding although all 33 artifacts load, and most of them need a verification method other than property testing. Because we designed the catalog on these claims, these results bound what the current catalog reaches; they do not measure scientific validity or extraction quality on unseen papers ( Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 ARA-PaperBench 语料库 [33, 45]（包含我们的 MMD-FUSE [5] 工件）的已编译 ARA 工件上，以及在 Simformer [18] 的另一个工件上评估 ARATest。 我们使用各论文及其发布代码的编译技能编译了 MMD-FUSE 和 Simformer 工件（第 5 节）。 在 33 个现有工件的 243 条声明中，55 条获得了通过保真度审查的声明，54 条完全绑定到报告的证据（22.2%）。 ARATest 判定了 40 条声明（16.5%）：其中 32 条成立，8 条与其映射的证据相矛盾。 排除五项仅检查报告摘要的判定后，剩余 35 条（14.4%）。 来源分诊将两处违规追溯到已发表论文中的错误；我们没有发现此前对这两处错误的任何报告，且两篇论文的作者均予以确认。 在每一例中，都有一个句子陈述的数字与该论文自身的表格相矛盾。 另有四处违规来自编译的工件。 十四条已绑定的声明仍无定论。 其余 189 条声明缺乏完整绑定，尽管全部 33 个工件都能加载，且其中大多数需要属性测试以外的验证方法。 由于我们是基于这些声明设计的目录，这些结果界定了当前目录所能覆盖的范围；它们并不能衡量在未见论文上的科学有效性或抽取质量（第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: ARATest detected all 553 553 faults that we seeded into reported tables and raised no false alarm on 19 valid controls. On the same evidence, a direct LLM judge detected 342 faults and a calculator-assisted judge 319, and they took nine to ten times longer per check ( Section 5.3 ). Replay of an unseeded finding traced an inconsistency in the compiled SEMA table to the compiler skill swapping two metric headers, while the published claim held ( Section 5.3.1 ). We also ran six property-based tests on the released code of two peer-reviewed papers. Their generators instantiate four family types, and the experiment-generator agent ran their experiments. Four of the six tests held on fresh runs. The other two exposed behaviors that the reported evidence could not show, but their registered rules left both tests inconclusive ( Section 5.4 ). In DissClaimer campaigns on three of the 33 artifacts, six of 11 checks held and none was violated. Our contributions are:
paragraphs.zh: ARATest 检测到了我们植入报告表格中的全部 553 个故障，并且在 19 个有效对照上没有发出任何错误警报。 在相同的证据上，直接 LLM 评判者检测到 342 个故障，借助计算器的评判者检测到 319 个故障，而且它们每次检查耗时是前者的九到十倍（第 5.3 节）。 对一个未植入发现的回放将编译后 SEMA 表格中的一处不一致追溯到了编译器技能交换了两个指标表头，而已发表的结论仍然成立（第 5.3.1 节）。 我们还对两篇经同行评审的论文所发布的代码运行了六个基于属性的测试。 它们的生成器实例化了四种族类型，实验生成智能体运行了它们的实验。 六个测试中有四个在全新运行中成立。 另外两个测试暴露了已报告证据无法展示的行为，但它们注册的规则使这两个测试都无定论（第 5.4 节）。 在针对 33 个制品中三个制品的 DissClaimer 活动中，11 项检查中有 6 项成立，且没有一项被违反。我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: An approach that approximates the semantics of research claims with abstract properties, fixed by a typed contract over relation, cases, scope, and numerical policy, and decided by a three-valued verdict semantics with replayable violation witnesses ( Section 3.1 and Section 3.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一种用抽象属性来近似研究论断语义的方法，这些属性由关于关系、案例、范围与数值策略的类型化契约固定，并通过带有可重放违规见证的三值判定语义来裁定（ Section 3.1 和 Section 3.6 ）。

paragraphs.en: Agent-native research artifacts (ARA) [ 33 ] provide a typed host for the claims and evidence that ARATest tests. They link claims and experiment plans in logic/ to code, configurations, and environments in src/ , results and logs in evidence/ , and research history in trace/ . The compiler skill builds these records from an existing paper or repository, while research-manager records decisions, experiments, and abandoned directions during an agent’s research loop. Provenance tags distinguish human input, model proposals, and executed work. rigor-reviewer assesses the resulting artifact. The ARA format and recording process are existing infrastructure. ARATest runs as another skill that adds executable claim checks to this workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体原生研究产物（ARA）[33] 为 ARATest 所测试的论断与证据提供了一个类型化的宿主。 它们将 logic/ 中的论断与实验计划，同 src/ 中的代码、配置与环境，evidence/ 中的结果与日志，以及 trace/ 中的研究历史关联起来。 编译技能从现有论文或代码仓库构建这些记录，而研究管理器则在智能体的研究循环中记录决策、实验以及被放弃的方向。 溯源标签用于区分人类输入、模型提议与已执行的工作。rigor-reviewer 对由此形成的研究产物进行评估。 ARA 格式与记录流程是已有的基础设施。 ARATest 作为另一个技能运行，为这一工作流添加可执行的论断检查。

paragraphs.en: Each claim entry in logic/claims.md records the assertion ( Statement ), its scope ( Conditions ), what would disprove it ( Falsification criteria ), and its current standing ( Status ). Proof links to supporting experiments, Evidence basis describes their evidence, and Dependencies names related claims. These fields help a reader or agent find the supporting work. They do not yet specify an executable oracle, a check that decides whether evidence passes. ARATest adds a declaration that states this oracle as a typed contract. The declaration also retains the source claim and its provenance, so a reviewer can check whether the binding is faithful.
paragraphs.zh: logic/claims.md 中的每条声明条目记录断言（Statement）、其适用范围（Conditions）、能推翻它的内容（Falsification criteria）及其当前状态（Status）。 Proof 链接到支持的实验，Evidence basis 描述这些实验的证据，Dependencies 列出相关的声明。 这些字段帮助读者或智能体找到支持性工作。 它们尚未指定可执行的 oracle，即判定证据是否通过的检查。 ARATest 添加了一个声明，将该 oracle 表述为类型化契约。 该声明还保留源声明及其来源信息，以便审阅者检查绑定是否忠实。

paragraphs.en: Property-based testing (PBT) checks a program against a stated property on many generated inputs. [ 9 ] introduced PBT with QuickCheck, a Haskell library that tests functions against properties written as ordinary Haskell functions. A property-based test has three parts. A property is a Boolean function that should return true on every input. For example, reversing a list twice should restore the list. A generator supplies inputs. QuickCheck derives a default generator from the property’s argument type, here random lists of integers, and users can write custom generators for the data a test requires. The oracle decides whether an input passes. In QuickCheck, the property serves as its own oracle, so a test fails when the property returns false. The failing input is a concrete counterexample that a developer can inspect and replay. If a developer mistakenly states that a single reversal leaves every list unchanged, QuickCheck reports a failing list such as [0,1] . When every generated case passes, the result is evidence for those cases only. It does not prove the property for all inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 基于属性的测试（PBT）在大量生成的输入上检查程序是否满足某个给定的属性。 [ 9 ] 通过 QuickCheck 引入了 PBT，QuickCheck 是一个 Haskell 库，它用写成普通 Haskell 函数的属性来测试函数。 一个基于属性的测试包含三个部分。 属性是一个布尔函数，应当在每个输入上都返回 true。 例如，将一个列表反转两次应当恢复原列表。 生成器负责提供输入。 QuickCheck 从属性的参数类型推导出默认生成器，这里是随机的整数列表，用户也可以为测试所需的数据编写自定义生成器。 判定器决定一个输入是否通过。 在 QuickCheck 中，属性本身就是它自己的判定器，因此当属性返回 false 时测试即失败。 失败的输入是一个具体的反例，开发者可以检查并重放它。 如果开发者错误地声明单次反转会让每个列表保持不变，QuickCheck 会报告一个失败的列表，例如 [0,1] 。 当所有生成的用例都通过时，其结果只是这些用例的证据。 它并不能证明该属性对所有输入都成立。

paragraphs.en: Many properties share one shape and differ only in what they apply to. A property skeleton states that shape once as a parameterized property, and instantiating the skeleton fills its parameters to yield a concrete test. [ 38 ] use skeletons to test tensor compilers and specify each skeleton by a relation, its applicability conditions, a way to construct test instances, and a rule for comparing outputs. A commutativity skeleton, for example, compares f ⁡ ( x , y ) f(x,y) with f ⁡ ( y , x ) f(y,x) . To instantiate it, a tester selects an operator for which commutativity holds, such as addition but not subtraction, generates compatible operands, and chooses exact equality or a floating-point tolerance. The relation alone therefore does not define a valid test. The applicability conditions and the comparison rule belong to the skeleton as much as the relation does.
paragraphs.zh: 许多属性共享同一种形式，仅在其适用对象上有所不同。 属性骨架将这种形式以参数化属性的方式陈述一次，实例化骨架时填充其参数即可得到一个具体测试。 [ 38 ] 使用骨架来测试张量编译器，并通过一个关系、其适用条件、一种构造测试实例的方法以及一条输出比较规则来定义每个骨架。 例如，一个交换性骨架会比较 f ⁡ ( x , y ) f(x,y) 与 f ⁡ ( y , x ) f(y,x) 。 要实例化它，测试者需选择一个满足交换性的算子（例如加法满足而减法不满足），生成兼容的操作数，并选择精确相等或浮点容差。 因此，仅靠关系本身并不能定义一个有效的测试。 适用条件和比较规则与关系一样，都属于骨架的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Research claims also recur in a few shapes. A comparative claim, for example, asserts that one quantity exceeds another on a set of cases. Unlike a commutativity skeleton, such a claim also has a scope , the cases it covers. A reversal outside that scope marks the claim’s boundary rather than a counterexample.
paragraphs.zh: 研究性论断也以几种形态反复出现。 例如，比较性论断断言某个量在一组案例上超过另一个量。 与交换性骨架不同，这类论断还有一个作用域，即它所覆盖的案例。 在该作用域之外出现的反转标志着论断的边界，而非反例。

paragraphs.en: ARATest makes a research claim reusable as a test. A declaration fixes the property that the claim implies, a property skeleton checks it, and a generator supplies cases. One generator reads reported evidence, and auto-research generators produce fresh measurements from experiments. Every generator feeds the same property without changing its operands, scope, or decision rule. For claim C01 ( Table 1 ), the declaration limits the property to LCA and Top-1 correlations on four named datasets, so ARATest does not treat every number in the artifact as evidence about the claim.

paragraphs.en: The two kinds of generator support two modes of testing an artifact. Integration testing runs the reported-evidence generator when a researcher or a research agent integrates new results into an ARA artifact. Because it reads only stored evidence, it returns a verdict while the results are being integrated, much as continuous integration tests a code change before it merges. The ARATest library runs this mode through its aratest test command ( Section 4 ). Continuous testing runs auto-research generators asynchronously and offline, much as OSS-Fuzz fuzzes open-source projects continuously [ 20 ] . Its experiments can take hours, so its failing cases return to the research agent later as feedback instead of blocking an integration. Our DissClaimer plugin runs this mode. It supplies an experiment-generator agent and a service that schedules the agent’s runs under a budget. DissClaimer saves every violation as a record that ARATest replays without the plugin.
paragraphs.zh: 这两类生成器支持两种测试制品（artifact）的模式。 当研究者或研究智能体将新结果整合进 ARA 制品时，集成测试会运行所报告证据生成器。 由于它只读取已存储的证据，它会在结果整合的过程中返回判定，就像持续集成在合并之前测试代码变更一样。 ARATest 库通过其 aratest test 命令运行这种模式（第 4 节）。 持续测试以异步和离线方式运行自动研究生成器，就像 OSS-Fuzz 持续地对开源项目进行模糊测试一样 [20]。 它的实验可能需要数小时，因此其失败用例会稍后作为反馈返回给研究智能体，而不是阻塞整合过程。 我们的 DissClaimer 插件运行这种模式。 它提供一个实验生成器智能体以及一个在该智能体运行预算内调度其运行的服务。 DissClaimer 将每个违规保存为一条记录，ARATest 可以在不借助插件的情况下重放该记录。

paragraphs.en: A claim C C becomes a test through three commitments. A domain predicate P C P_{C} defines which cases may test it. An observation map O C O_{C} selects the quantities that the claim concerns. A relation Q C Q_{C} states the required comparison, including its quantifier, aggregation, and numeric or uncertainty policy. A case x x takes the claim’s statistical unit: it can be one pair of table cells, a matched pair of runs, or an entire seed family when the claim concerns an aggregate. Keeping that unit explicit prevents a generator from replacing a claim about a mean with a per-seed requirement.

paragraphs.en: A typed declaration records these commitments. Its Kind selects a skeleton variant. Its Domain binds the operands, scope, and policy. A property skeleton supplies versioned library code for that variant, and a generator supplies cases without rewriting that code. For C01 ( Table 1 ), P C P_{C} admits the four named datasets, O C O_{C} selects the two correlations, and Q C Q_{C} requires the LCA correlation to exceed the Top-1 correlation on each dataset. paragraphs.en: This contract has three requirements. Fixed evidence and a fixed declaration yield the same verdict (R1). Every violation carries the observations that decide it (R2). ARATest can reuse the declaration across cases without asking a model to judge each case (R3). These requirements adapt the reusable properties and counterexamples of PBT to research records [ 9 , 19 ] . They do not remove the semantic work of translating a claim or registering a new experiment family. Because hosted model judgments can vary even at temperature zero [ 52 ] , ARATest lets a model propose and review declarations but never compute a verdict from frozen evidence (R1).

paragraphs.en: To avoid writing a new property for each claim under test, we design a catalog of reusable property skeletons. Each skeleton implements a recurring relation once, such as one method outperforming another on named datasets. A declaration then supplies the skeleton’s scientific operands. We adapt the initial catalog from industrial PBT [ 19 ] , metamorphic relations [ 8 ] , and property-specification patterns [ 14 ] . A model that proposes a declaration ( Section 3.3 ) selects an implemented skeleton variant rather than inventing a new one. The relation alone cannot express a claim’s quantifier or cohort. “Better on every dataset” requires each named comparison to hold, while a minimum-count claim permits losses. “Better than every baseline” requires the eligible cohort rather than one convenient reference. The declaration therefore retains aggregation, groups, operand roles, scope, and numeric policy. We show these obligations in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了避免为每个待测断言编写新的属性，我们设计了一个可复用属性骨架目录。 每个骨架只实现一次反复出现的关系，例如某个方法在指定数据集上优于另一个方法。 声明随后为骨架提供其科学操作数。 我们借鉴工业级 PBT [ 19 ]、蜕变关系 [ 8 ] 以及属性规约模式 [ 14 ] 构建了初始目录。 提出声明的模型（见 3.3 节）会选择一个已实现的骨架变体，而不是自行发明新的骨架。 仅有关系无法表达断言的量词或队列。“在每个数据集上更好”要求每个具名比较都成立，而最小计数断言则允许失败。“优于每个基线”要求使用合格队列而非某个便利的参照。 因此，声明保留了聚合方式、分组、操作数角色、作用域和数值策略。 我们在表 2 中展示了这些义务。

paragraphs.en: ARATest implements six reported-evidence skeleton variants, five generative skeleton variants, and a separate functional-agreement relation, which we list in Table 2 . Each skeleton has a typed parameter block, an evidence resolver, an oracle, and an aggregation rule [ 38 , 32 ] . The declaration fills the parameters; fixed library code resolves, decides, and aggregates (R1). Adding a skeleton variant requires implementing and registering its code under a new Kind value. The generative variants compile run plans for auto-research generators. The functional-agreement relation compares saved implementation and reference outputs on registered inputs. The step that supplies the cases executes both computations and retains their identities and outputs; replay does not execute them again. Sampled agreement remains inconclusive , while a mismatch retains a counterexample ( Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: ARATest 实现了六个报告证据骨架变体、五个生成式骨架变体，以及一个独立的功能一致性关系，我们在表 2 中列出这些内容。 每个骨架都有一个带类型的参数块、一个证据解析器、一个判定器（oracle）和一个聚合规则 [38, 32]。 声明负责填充参数；固定的库代码负责解析、判定和聚合（R1）。 添加一个骨架变体需要在新的 Kind 值下实现并注册其代码。 生成式变体为自动研究生成器编译运行计划。 功能一致性关系在已注册的输入上比较已保存的实现输出与参考输出。 提供测试用例的步骤会执行两个计算并保留它们的标识和输出；重放不会再次执行它们。 抽样一致仍然不能得出结论，而不匹配则会保留一个反例（第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: To guide the initial catalog design, we read the statement and falsification criterion of 136 claims in the 23 PaperBench artifacts of ARA-PaperBench. We then coded each claim against the current catalog ( Figure 2 ). For the 41 claims that have a declaration ( Section 5.2 ), we used the skeleton that most of the declaration’s properties use. We assigned 102 claims ( 75 % 75\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) to the six reported-evidence variants, including 31 numeric constraints and 29 comparative claims. Another three claims described a monotonic trend or an equivalence within a margin, which only a generative variant expresses. We placed the remaining 31 claims in Others: theorems, qualitative or mechanistic analyses, correlations, growth rates, and noninferiority claims without a stated margin. This classification does not measure whether an implemented declaration preserves every obligation or binds all required evidence. In Section 5.2 , we instead report 54 faithful, fully bound claims out of 243 ( 22.2 % 22.2\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) after fidelity review on the corpus that guided the catalog. That development result is not independent scientific validation.
paragraphs.zh: 为指导初始目录设计，我们阅读了 ARA-PaperBench 的 23 个 PaperBench 产物中 136 条主张的陈述与证伪标准。 随后我们针对当前目录对每条主张进行了编码（图 2）。 对于有声明（第 5.2 节）的 41 条主张，我们使用了该声明大多数属性所采用的骨架。 我们将 102 条主张（75\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}）归入六个已报告证据的变体中，其中包括 31 条数值约束和 29 条比较性主张。 另有三条主张描述了单调趋势或某个容差范围内的等价性，只有生成式变体才能表达这类主张。 我们把其余 31 条主张归入“其他”：定理、定性或机制性分析、相关性、增长率，以及未给出容差的非劣效性主张。 这种分类并不衡量某个已实现声明是否保留了每一项义务或绑定了所有必需的证据。 相反，在第 5.2 节中，我们对用于指导目录构建的语料库进行忠实性审查后，报告了 243 条主张中有 54 条忠实且完全绑定的主张（22.2\text{\,}\mathrm{\%}）。 这一开发结果并非独立的科学验证。

A recognized kind without an implementation receives pending-skeleton ; an unknown kind receives unclassified . In both cases, ARATest returns no verdict and leaves the claim untested. paragraphs.en: A skeleton stays generic until a declaration binds it to one claim. We build on top of the claim record in ARA ( Section 2.1 ), adding two fields, Kind and Domain , and leaving its existing fields unchanged. Kind selects a skeleton variant from the supported vocabulary ( Table 2 ). The schema rejects any other value, so ARATest leaves a claim with an invented label untested. Domain is a kind-specific typed declaration of what the selected skeleton variant ranges over. It names the quantities that O C O_{C} selects, the scope that P C P_{C} admits, and the comparator, aggregation, and numeric or uncertainty policy that Q C Q_{C} applies. Each generator reads the parts it needs ( Section 3.4 and Section 3.5 ). We use the claim’s Statement in ARA to determine the scope in Domain . For C01 ( Table 1 ), Kind is comparative, and Domain names the LCA and Top-1 cells, the greater-than comparator, and the four datasets that the Statement covers. The transformation in Figure 3 separates these fields from the library code that consumes them.

paragraphs.en: We intend the research agent to write Kind and Domain while it does the research. research-manager already records each claim during the agent’s research loop ( Section 2.1 ). When the agent states a claim, it has the experiment plan, the metric, and the result tables at hand. It can therefore declare the claim’s relation, operands, and scope in the same step, under the same provenance tags as the other ARA fields. An author can supply or revise these fields in the same way. The artifacts we evaluate lack Kind and Domain , because the released research-manager and compiler skills do not yet write declarations, and compiler built these artifacts from finished work. For the evaluation only, we therefore add declarations post hoc. Given a compiled claim, its evidence, and the catalog, an agent fills a skeleton’s operands, comparator, scope, and policy under an ai-suggested tag, or records why no skeleton expresses the claim. This step instantiates library code. It neither discovers a new skeleton nor writes the code that computes the verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 我们打算让研究智能体在开展研究的同时撰写 Kind 与 Domain。research-manager 已经在智能体的研究循环期间记录每一条论断（第 2.1 节）。 当智能体陈述一条论断时，它手头已有实验计划、指标和结果表。 因此，它可以在同一步骤中声明该论断的关系、操作数和范围，并使用与其他 ARA 字段相同的溯源标签。 作者也可以以同样的方式提供或修改这些字段。 我们评估的成果缺少 Kind 与 Domain，因为已发布的 research-manager 和编译器技能尚未写入声明，而且 compiler 是基于已完成的工作构建这些成果的。 因此，仅为了评估目的，我们事后补充声明。 给定一条已编译的论断、其证据和目录，智能体会在 ai-suggested 标签下填写某个骨架的操作数、比较符、范围和策略，或记录没有骨架能够表达该论断的原因。 这一步骤是对库代码的实例化。 它既不发现新的骨架，也不编写计算结论的代码。

paragraphs.en: Following the proposal-and-check pattern of LLM-Modulo [ 26 ] , ARATest validates the schema and evidence bindings of each proposed declaration. The agent saves its first attempt before it sees any verdict. Binding does not establish fidelity: a bound declaration can still select the wrong metric or test an easier fragment of the claim. A fresh-context AI reviewer therefore compares each declaration, or each recorded reason for skipping a claim, with the claim and its evidence before checking, and we report fidelity apart from verdicts ( Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 LLM-Modulo [26] 的「提出—检验」模式，ARATest 验证每个被提出声明的模式（schema）与证据绑定。 该智能体在看到任何判定结果之前，会先保存其第一次尝试。 绑定并不能确立忠实性：一个已绑定的声明仍然可能选择错误的指标，或只检验论断中较容易的部分。 因此，一个全新上下文的 AI 审稿人会在检验之前，将每个声明（或每条记录的跳过理由）与该论断及其证据进行比对，并且我们将忠实性与判定结果分开报告（第 5.2 节）。

sents.zh: 遵循 LLM-Modulo [26] 的「提出—检验」模式，ARATest 验证每个被提出声明的模式（schema）与证据绑定。

paragraphs.en: An instantiated property still needs cases to check. The reported-evidence generator draws them from evidence that the artifact already reports: it enumerates the table coordinates named by the declaration. For this generator, Domain identifies the evidence table, the two operands, the comparator, the in-scope coordinates, the widened coordinates that the claim excludes, and the numeric policy. Domain also records source contracts: which part of a cell each operand reads, which values are approximate, and which complete population a count ranges over. The generator reads stored cells through source-preserving readers, which keep each cell’s original text, position, printed precision, and approximation markers. It neither samples cases nor runs new experiments. It binds no figures, prose quantities, or cross-table relations. For C01, the dataset axis in Domain yields four in-scope LCA–Top-1 pairs and the excluded ImageNet-v2 pair ( Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 已实例化的属性仍需用例来进行检验。 所述证据生成器从工件（artifact）已经报告的证据中提取用例：它枚举声明中所指明的表格坐标。 对于该生成器而言，域（Domain）标识证据表、两个操作数、比较符、在范围内的坐标，以及该断言所排除的放宽坐标和数值策略。 域还记录源契约：每个操作数读取单元格的哪一部分、哪些值是近似值，以及某个计数范围所覆盖的完整总体。 生成器通过保留源信息的读取器读取存储的单元格，这些读取器保留每个单元格的原始文本、位置、打印精度和近似标记。 它既不采样用例，也不运行新实验。 它不绑定任何数字、文字表述的数量或跨表关系。 对于 C01，域中的数据集轴给出四个在范围内的 LCA–Top-1 数据对，以及被排除的 ImageNet-v2 数据对（ 表 1 ）。

paragraphs.en: We implement this generator and its skeletons as a table auditor. The auditor represents declaration variants as a Pydantic discriminated union, ScopeAuditSpec . The auditor’s bind function resolves the selected claim and table, checks the axes and scope values, and requires each operand to identify a numeric cell uniquely. A binding failure stops the audit instead of silently dropping a case, because no witness can name an operand that resolves to several cells or none (R2). The deterministic audit_scope function evaluates the bound cases and returns a ScopeFinding that records each deciding pair’s coordinates, values, and difference, so a reader can replay the verdict.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将此生成器及其骨架实现为一个表格审计器。 该审计器将声明变体表示为一个 Pydantic 可辨识联合类型 ScopeAuditSpec。 该审计器的 bind 函数会解析所选的论断和表格，检查轴与范围值，并要求每个操作数唯一地标识一个数值单元格。 绑定失败会中止审计，而不是静默丢弃该案例，因为没有见证能够指称一个解析到多个单元格或零个单元格的操作数（R2）。 确定性的 audit_scope 函数会评估已绑定的案例并返回一个 ScopeFinding，记录每个决定性数对的坐标、数值和差值，从而让读者能够复现该判定。

paragraphs.en: The skeleton checks the cases, using the declared comparator and displayed precision rather than a model’s judgment. For values a a and b b , it computes d = a − b d=a-b and a resolution gate ϵ = max ⁡ ( u a , u b ) / 2 \epsilon=\max(u_{a},u_{b})/2 , where u a u_{a} and u b u_{b} are the units of the last displayed decimal places of a a and b b . A pair with an approximate cell, or with | d | < ϵ |d|<\epsilon , is inconclusive . Otherwise, the comparator decides the pair. The boundary | d | = ϵ |d|=\epsilon is decisive, while equal prints establish no order. This gate does not test statistical significance. An effect-magnitude claim uses its declared tolerance instead ( Figure 12 ). The skeleton then applies the declared aggregation and the rules in Table 3 from top to bottom, examining widened pairs only after every in-scope pair passes. For widened failures, fixed rules distinguish explicit exclusions and closed enumerations from undeclared universal scope. Ambiguous phrasing remains inconclusive.
paragraphs.zh: 骨架通过声明的比较器和显示精度来检查用例，而非依赖模型的主观判断。 对于值 a a 和 b b ，它计算 d = a − b d=a-b 和分辨率门限 ϵ = max ⁡ ( u a , u b ) / 2 \epsilon=\max(u_{a},u_{b})/2 ，其中 u a u_{a} 和 u b u_{b} 分别是 a a 和 b b 最后显示的小数位的单位。 带有近似单元格的一对值，或满足 | d | < ϵ |d|<\epsilon 的一对值，判定为不确定（inconclusive）。 否则，由比较器对该对值作出判定。 边界情况 | d | = ϵ |d|=\epsilon 是可判定的，而完全相同的显示值则不建立任何顺序。 该门限并不检验统计显著性。 效应量级的主张则改用其声明的容差来判断（图 12）。 随后骨架应用声明的聚合方式以及表 3 中的规则，自上而下逐条执行，只有当所有范围内的一对值全部通过后，才检查放宽范围后的一对值。 对于放宽范围后未通过的情况，固定规则将显式排除和封闭枚举与未声明的全域范围区分开来。 含糊的措辞保持不确定（inconclusive）的判定。

paragraphs.en: Reported evidence can test a claim only where the authors measured it. To obtain fresh measurements instead of reading stored ones, we delegate experiments to an AI agent that plans and runs them [ 29 ] . We call this agent the experiment-generator agent . We neither hard-code the experiments nor ask the agent to invent them. Instead, each generator describes one experiment family , a way to obtain related cases such as resampling random seeds or permuting row order while the claim’s task stays fixed. When such a generator draws cases, it gives the agent the claim’s ARA or the paper’s code repository together with the family description. The agent runs the experiments and returns observations of the case type that the property expects. We call these generators auto-research generators . The property still decides each case, but a failing case on this path serves as feedback rather than a refutation ( Figure 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 报告的证据只能在作者测量过的范围内检验一个论断。 为了获得全新的测量结果而非读取已存储的结果，我们把实验委托给一个能规划并运行实验的智能体（AI agent）[ 29 ] 。 我们将这个智能体称为实验生成智能体（experiment-generator agent）。 我们既不硬编码这些实验，也不要求智能体自行发明实验。 相反，每个生成器描述一个实验族（experiment family），即在论断的任务保持不变的情况下获得相关案例的一种方式，例如重采样随机种子或打乱行顺序。 当这样的生成器抽取案例时，它会向智能体提供该论断的 ARA 或论文的代码仓库，以及该实验族的描述。 智能体运行实验，并返回该属性所期望的案例类型的观察结果。 我们将这些生成器称为自动研究生成器（auto-research generators）。 属性仍然对每个案例进行判定，但在这条路径上失败的案例只作为反馈，而非反驳（图 4）。

sents.zh: 报告的证据只能在作者测量过的范围内检验一个论断。

paragraphs.en: For an auto-research generator, Domain supplies the controls and uncertainty policy that each family needs. The family description instructs the agent not to substitute a metric or method variant, drop a baseline, or loosen the decision rule after observing a failure. Each case must also keep the unit over which Q C Q_{C} quantifies. Matched runs retain the declared controls, and a seed batch retains its statistical unit and aggregation, so one adverse seed does not refute a claim about a mean. Comparing a run with a published value differs from comparing it with a baseline and requires a separate declaration. For C01 ( Table 1 ), fresh evidence would still compare LCA and Top-1 predictive correlations on the four named datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 对于自动研究生成器而言，领域（Domain）提供了每个系列所需的控制项与不确定性策略。 系列描述指示智能体不得在观察到失败后替换指标或方法变体、删减基线，或放宽决策规则。 每个案例还必须保留 Q C Q_{C} 所量化的单元。 匹配的运行保留声明的控制项，种子批次保留其统计单元与聚合方式，因此单个不利种子不能推翻关于均值的结论。 将某次运行与已发表数值进行比较，不同于将其与基线进行比较，需要单独的声明。 对于 C01（表 1），新的证据仍应在四个指定数据集上比较 LCA 与 Top-1 的预测相关性。

sents.en: For an auto-research generator, Domain supplies the controls and uncertainty policy that each family needs.
sents.zh: 对于自动研究生成器而言，领域（Domain）提供了每个系列所需的控制项与不确定性策略。

sents.en: The family description instructs the agent not to substitute a metric or method variant, drop a baseline, or loosen the decision rule after observing a failure.
sents.zh: 系列描述指示智能体不得在观察到失败后替换指标或方法变体、删减基线，或放宽决策规则。

sents.en: Each case must also keep the unit over which Q C Q_{C} quantifies.
sents.zh: 每个案例还必须保留 Q C Q_{C} 所量化的单元。

sents.en: Matched runs retain the declared controls, and a seed batch retains its statistical unit and aggregation, so one adverse seed does not refute a claim about a mean.
sents.zh: 匹配的运行保留声明的控制项，种子批次保留其统计单元与聚合方式，因此单个不利种子不能推翻关于均值的结论。

sents.en: Comparing a run with a published value differs from comparing it with a baseline and requires a separate declaration.
sents.zh: 将某次运行与已发表数值进行比较，不同于将其与基线进行比较，需要单独的声明。

sents.en: For C01 ( Table 1 ), fresh evidence would still compare LCA and Top-1 predictive correlations on the four named datasets.
sents.zh: 对于 C01（表 1），新的证据仍应在四个指定数据集上比较 LCA 与 Top-1 的预测相关性。

paragraphs.en: Our Python library enforces the case type through one protocol ( Appendix A ). A Generator names its case type C , such as a batch of seeded runs or a matched pair of runs. Each call to its generate method returns a batch of cases of that type with its coverage: how many cases the generator meant to supply and why any are missing. The property must take the same type, and ARATest withholds the verdict on a batch whose coverage is incomplete. The reported-evidence generator ( Section 3.4 ) is a Generator whose cases are pairs of stored table cells. An auto-research generator runs one experiment family for one claim. Each call dispatches the experiment-generator agent with the artifact, the declaration, and the family’s description, and the generator accepts only returned cases of type C . ARATest fixes this request and the report format, but not the agent. An agent registers under the aratest.agents entry-point group, so any agent that accepts the request and reports cases can serve. Our DissClaimer plugin registers one such agent, which runs each experiment in an OpenHands workspace [ 49 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的 Python 库通过一个协议（附录 A）来强制执行用例类型。 一个 Generator 将其用例类型命名为 C，例如一批带种子的运行或一对匹配的运行。 每次调用其 generate 方法都会返回一批该类型的用例及其覆盖情况：该智能体（生成器）打算提供多少个用例，以及缺失了哪些及原因。 该属性必须采用相同的类型，当一批用例的覆盖不完整时，ARATest 会暂缓给出判定。 已报告证据生成器（第 3.4 节）是一种 Generator，其用例是成对的已存储表格单元格。 自动研究生成器针对一个断言运行一个实验族。 每次调用都会携带制品、声明以及该实验族的描述来调度实验生成器智能体，并且该生成器只接受返回的 C 类型用例。 ARATest 固定了这个请求和报告格式，但不固定智能体。 智能体通过 aratest.agents 入口点组进行注册，因此任何接受该请求并报告用例的智能体都可以提供服务。 我们的 DissClaimer 插件注册了一个这样的智能体，它在一个 OpenHands 工作区[49]中运行每个实验。

sents.zh: 我们的 DissClaimer 插件注册了一个这样的智能体，它在一个 OpenHands 工作区[49]中运行每个实验。

paragraphs.en: A valid declaration does not guarantee a valid run. The agent implements each experiment itself and may change more than the family allows, for example by substituting a metric, dropping a baseline, or skipping a control. Agent-designed probes can also include cases that human experts reject [ 2 ] . We therefore do not treat a failing case from an auto-research generator as a refutation of the claim. ARATest reports it as feedback : a candidate violation together with the agent’s code, logs, and observations. The feedback suggests the next experiment to run or a part of the artifact to revise, and the user decides whether the failing case reveals a claim defect or a flawed run ( Section 3.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 有效的声明并不保证有效的运行。 智能体自行实现每个实验，并且可能做出超出该系列所允许范围的改动，例如替换指标、删去基线或跳过对照。 智能体设计的探针还可能包含人类专家会拒绝的用例 [ 2 ] 。 因此，我们不把来自自动研究生成器的失败用例当作对该声明的反驳。 ARATest 将其作为反馈报告：一个候选违规项，连同智能体的代码、日志和观察结果。 该反馈提示下一个要运行的实验或工件中需要修订的部分，而由用户判断该失败用例暴露的是声明缺陷还是有缺陷的运行（第 3.6 节）。

paragraphs.en: By default, the library provides four family types: • SeedResampling : reruns the experiment under fresh random seeds. • OrderPermutation : reorders data rows while keeping groups, pairs, and partitions intact. • NullCalibration : runs the method on data drawn under a null hypothesis to measure its error rate. • ConfigSubstitution : replaces one released configuration value with a declared alternative, such as a value stated in the paper, once the experiment-generator agent admits the substitution. The first three types vary randomness that claims rarely commit to, so they need no admission check. A claim may instead fix a configuration value, as a claim stated at a learning rate of 0.1 fixes the learning rate. Before it runs a substitution, the experiment-generator agent therefore reads the ARA and decides whether the claim leaves the substituted value open. Users can extend the library with their own family types. Each family type is data: an instruction, a parameters model, and a case type. Users register a new type under the aratest.families entry-point group. A family type is generic, and an instance binds it to one artifact and claim. The six property-based tests in our evaluation draw cases from six instances of these four types ( Section 5.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 默认情况下，该库提供四种族类型：• SeedResampling：在全新随机种子下重新运行实验。• OrderPermutation：在保持组、对和分区不变的前提下重新排列数据行。• NullCalibration：在零假设下生成的数据上运行该方法，以测量其错误率。• ConfigSubstitution：在实验生成智能体允许替换的前提下，将某个已发布的配置值替换为已声明的替代值，例如论文中陈述的值。 前三种类型改变的是结论很少明确承诺的随机性，因此无需准入检查。 结论也可能会固定某个配置值，例如一个在学习率为 0.1 时陈述的结论就固定了学习率。 因此，在执行替换之前，实验生成智能体会读取 ARA，并判断该结论是否将被替换的值留作开放。 用户可以使用自己的族类型来扩展该库。 每个族类型都是数据：一条指令、一个参数模型和一个用例类型。 用户在 aratest.families 入口点组下注册新类型。 族类型是泛型的，一个实例会将其绑定到一个工件和一个结论。 我们评估中的六个基于属性的测试从这四种类型的六个实例中抽取用例（第 5.4 节）。

sents.zh: 我们评估中的六个基于属性的测试从这四种类型的六个实例中抽取用例（第 5.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: In our design, the research agent chooses a claim’s auto-research generators when it states the claim, as it does for the claim’s declaration ( Section 3.3 ). It names the family types that apply and fills their parameters, such as the seed count, the permuted partition, or the substituted value. It records this binding with the claim in the ARA under an ai-suggested tag, much as a PBT user annotates a test with its generators. An author can supply or revise the binding in the same way. ARATest does not choose generators. It reads the recorded binding. For a ConfigSubstitution instance, the experiment-generator agent declines the substitution and returns no cases if the claim fixes the substituted value.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的设计中，研究智能体在陈述断言时会选择该断言的自动研究生成器，就像它为该断言的声明所做的那样（第 3.3 节）。 它会指明适用的生成器族类型并填写其参数，例如种子数量、被置换的分区或被替换的值。 它会以 ai-suggested 标签将这一绑定与断言一起记录在 ARA 中，就像 PBT 用户用生成器标注测试一样。 作者也可以用同样的方式提供或修改这一绑定。 ARATest 不选择生成器。 它读取已记录的绑定。 对于 ConfigSubstitution 实例，如果断言固定了被替换的值，实验生成器智能体会拒绝该替换并不返回任何用例。

paragraphs.en: For each remaining instance, ARATest dispatches the experiment-generator agent with the family description, the declaration, and the ARA at a pinned revision ( Figure 5 ). The agent first reads the ARA : the claim in logic/claims.md , the experiment plan behind its Proof link, the entry point and configuration in src/ , and the reported value in evidence/ . It then reruns the released code at the original setting . If that run does not recover the reported value, the agent stops and returns no cases. Otherwise, it plans the runs that the family calls for, where a run executes the released code once at one setting. ARATest freezes the plan before any run starts . The agent patches only the dimension that the family varies , executes the runs in a pinned container under a fixed time and compute budget , and writes a JSON file with the measurements, controls, code diff, and logs . ARATest ’s generator parses the file into cases of the family’s case type, rejects a malformed file, and passes the cases to the property. The agent chooses how to realize the experiment and decides whether to admit a substitution, but it does not write the property.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个剩余实例，ARATest 会将实验生成器智能体与族描述、声明以及固定修订版本的 ARA 一起派发（图 5）。 该智能体首先阅读 ARA：logic/claims.md 中的声明、其 Proof 链接背后的实验计划、src/ 中的入口点和配置，以及 evidence/ 中报告的数值。 然后它在原始设置下重新运行已发布的代码。 如果该次运行未能复现报告的数值，智能体将停止且不返回任何用例。 否则，它会规划该族所需的运行，其中一次运行即在某一设置下执行一次已发布的代码。 ARATest 在任何运行开始之前冻结该计划。 智能体仅修改该族所变化的维度，在固定的时间和计算预算下于固定容器中执行这些运行，并写入一个包含测量数据、控制项、代码差异和日志的 JSON 文件。 ARATest 的生成器将该文件解析为该族用例类型的用例，拒绝格式错误的文件，并将这些用例传递给该属性。 智能体自行选择如何实现实验，并决定是否接受替换，但它不编写该属性。

paragraphs.en: The library combines generators with two combinators. Each call to one_of draws a batch from the next of several generators in turn, and frequency weights that choice. Both require their generators to share a case type, so a combination draws every case in one statistical unit. For MMD-FUSE [ 5 ] , the seed and row-order instances both yield batches of repeated two-sample tests, so one generator can draw from either. The null-calibration and configuration-substitution instances test other claims with their own declarations, whose properties take other case types. DissClaimer ’s continuous testing service schedules each family binding separately and does not combine generators.
paragraphs.zh: 该库将多个生成器与两个组合器结合在一起。 每次调用 one_of 都会依次从若干生成器的下一个中抽取一批样本，并通过频率权重对该选择进行加权。 两者都要求其生成器共享同一案例类型，因此一个组合会在同一个统计单元内抽取所有案例。 对于 MMD-FUSE [ 5 ] ，种子实例和行序实例都会产生重复的双样本检验批次，因此一个生成器可以从两者中任选其一进行抽取。 零假设校准实例和配置替换实例则用它们各自的声明检验其他断言，这些声明的属性采用其他案例类型。 DissClaimer 的持续测试服务会单独调度每个族绑定，并不组合生成器。

sents.zh: 零假设校准实例和配置替换实例则用它们各自的声明检验其他断言，这些声明的属性采用其他案例类型。

sents.en: DissClaimer ’s continuous testing service schedules each family binding separately and does not combine generators.
sents.zh: DissClaimer 的持续测试服务会单独调度每个族绑定，并不组合生成器。

paragraphs.en: ARATest retains each instance’s frozen plan and returned JSON file, so a reader can recompute the verdict without rerunning the research code. For that replay to test the same claim, retained cases keep the claim’s unit: a seed family preserves the randomness over which its claim quantifies, and a reduced counterexample must retain the original scope, pairing, and controls. Only completed runs reach the property. ARATest records every incomplete run with its reason, so a reader can see which runs produced no result.
paragraphs.zh: ARATest 保留每个实例的冻结计划以及返回的 JSON 文件，因此读者无需重新运行研究代码即可重新计算判定结论。 为了让这种重放能测试同一个断言，被保留的案例会保持该断言的单位：种子族群保留其断言所量化的随机性，而化简后的反例必须保留原始范围、配对和控制条件。 只有已完成的运行才会触及该性质。 ARATest 会记录每一次未完成的运行及其原因，因此读者可以看到哪些运行没有产生结果。

paragraphs.en: A verdict decides the instantiated property on the recorded evidence, not the source claim. The record keeps the witness: the deciding cells, or the agent’s frozen design, run record, and observations. Because each case outcome depends on that case alone ( Definition 3.1 ), the witness suffices to replay a violation.

paragraphs.en: For a universal claim, a holds verdict has neither guarantee, because one added failing case turns it into violated . The replay guarantee ( Proposition 3.1 ) does not cover over_claim , which rests on widened cases outside X X . Replaying it also requires every admitted case, because the rules examine widened pairs only after all admitted pairs pass. Replay checks only the step from evidence to verdict. Attributing a fault to the source work requires checking that the compiler skill did not paraphrase the claim or mislabel a table, and that the declaration bound the right metric. The record keeps the Evidence basis and the declaration so that a reader can make this check.
paragraphs.zh: 对于全称命题，hold 判定没有任何保证，因为只要新增一个失败案例，它就会变为 violated。 重放保证（命题 3.1）不覆盖 over_claim，后者依赖于 X X 之外的 widened 案例。 重放它也需要每一个 admitted 案例，因为规则只有在所有 admitted 对都通过之后才会检查 widened 对。 重放只检查从证据到判定这一步。 要把故障归因于源工作，需要检查编译 skill 是否改写了该命题或错误标注了表格，以及声明是否绑定了正确的指标。 记录保留 Evidence basis 和声明，以便读者能够进行这一检查。

paragraphs.en: ARATest reports violations as warnings and leaves the decision about a defect to its user, much as GCC lets its user promote warnings to errors with -Werror . By default, only the four fault verdicts in Table 3 ( over_claim , scope_flip , inconsistency , and weakened ) recommend changing Status to refuted . A stricter user can treat every violation as a defect, even on the auto-research path. A statistical rejection holds only under the declared uncertainty policy. A pass corroborates only the obligations and cases checked, so ARATest never promotes the claim.
paragraphs.zh: ARATest 将违规报告为警告，并把缺陷的决定权留给用户，就像 GCC 允许用户通过 -Werror 将警告提升为错误一样。 默认情况下，只有表 3 中的四种错误判定（over_claim、scope_flip、inconsistency 和 weakened）会建议将 Status 更改为 refuted。 更严格的用户可以将每一次违规都视为缺陷，即使在自动研究路径上也是如此。 统计学上的拒绝仅在声明的确定性策略下成立。 一次通过仅能佐证所检查的义务和用例，因此 ARATest 永远不会提升该声明。

paragraphs.en: On the auto-research path, a reader must also use the code diff and controls to check that the agent’s run realized the family. This check matters for a pass too, because a run that left the seed unchanged would return holds without testing the claim. By default, a violation on this path is feedback, not a Status recommendation ( Section 3.5.1 ). A baseline that does not reproduce yields no cases, a finding about the released code rather than the claim. An inconclusive result neither supports nor weakens the claim.
paragraphs.zh: 在自动研究路径上，读者还必须利用代码差异和控制项来检查智能体的运行是否实现了该族。 这项检查对通过判定同样重要，因为一次未改动种子的运行会在未检验该断言的情况下返回成立。 默认情况下，该路径上的违规是反馈，而不是状态建议（见第 3.5.1 节）。 无法复现的基线不会产生任何案例，这是关于已发布代码的发现，而非关于该断言的发现。 不确定的结果既不支持也不削弱该断言。

paragraphs.en: We now show what a user writes and what ARATest returns. On two claims from ARA-PaperBench, we walk through the three steps of integration testing: declaring a claim, testing it, and replaying a violation. We then bind an experiment family to a claim for continuous testing and add a new family to the library. We ran every command whose output we show, and aratest validate accepts every spec we show. A listing marks each place where we shortened the text.
paragraphs.zh: 现在我们展示用户输入的内容以及 ARATest 返回的内容。 针对 ARA-PaperBench 中的两个声明，我们走一遍集成测试的三个步骤：声明声明、测试它，以及回放一次违规。 随后我们将一个实验族绑定到一个声明以进行持续测试，并向库中添加一个新的实验族。 我们运行了所展示输出的每一条命令，并且 aratest validate 接受我们展示的每一个规范。 列表标记了每一处我们缩短文本的位置。

paragraphs.en: A user declares the tests of an ARA in one file, aratest/spec.yaml , inside the artifact. The spec holds no code and repeats no reported number. It names table coordinates, and ARATest reads the numbers from the evidence files. In Figure 6 , we declare the comparison of claim C01 in LCA-on-the-Line ( Table 1 ).

sents.en: In Figure 6 , we declare the comparison of claim C01 in LCA-on-the-Line ( Table 1 ).
sents.zh: 在图 6 中，我们声明了 LCA-on-the-Line（表 1）中论断 C01 的比较。

paragraphs.en: The spec has two parts. The evidence block tells ARATest how to read each evidence table into measurements. The correlation table lists one predictor per row and labels each column with a dataset and a statistic, such as ImgN-S PEA . The block therefore takes each cell’s metric from the statistic, renames the row axis to predictor and the column group to dataset , and maps the row labels to LCA and Top1 . The claims block binds C01 to the comparative skeleton, whose fields fill the contract of Section 3.1 . The fields metric , subject , and reference define the observation map O C O_{C} , and in_scope defines the domain predicate P C P_{C} . The relation Q C Q_{C} applies comparator on every in-scope dataset. The widen list names ImageNet-v2, which the claim excludes, as a widened case. Before testing, aratest validate lists every property that would not bind and why, such as an operand that resolves to no cell.
paragraphs.zh: 该规范包含两部分。 证据块告诉 ARATest 如何将每个证据表读取为测量值。 相关表每行列出一个预测变量，并用数据集和统计量标注每一列，例如 ImgN-S PEA。 因此，该块从统计量中提取每个单元格的度量，将行轴重命名为 predictor，将列组重命名为 dataset，并将行标签映射为 LCA 和 Top1。 主张块将 C01 绑定到比较骨架，其字段填入 3.1 节的契约。 字段 metric、subject 和 reference 定义了观测映射 O C O_{C}，而 in_scope 定义了域谓词 P C P_{C}。 关系 Q C Q_{C} 在每个范围内数据集上应用 comparator。 widen 列表将主张所排除的 ImageNet-v2 列为拓宽案例。 在测试之前，aratest validate 会列出每个无法绑定及无法绑定的原因，例如解析不到任何单元格的操作数。

paragraphs.en: We wrote this declaration for the walkthrough, and it is not one of the RQ1 declarations. It covers only the comparison in Table 1 . The compiled C01 also requires LCA’s R 2 R^{2} and Pearson correlation to exceed 0.7 on each dataset, which a complete declaration would check with numeric constraints.

paragraphs.en: A violated claim leaves a record that replays without the artifact. In Figure 8 , we test claim C02 of APT [ 54 ] , one of the two paper errors in Section 5.2 , under its RQ1 declaration. The claim states that APT trains 8.4 × \times faster than LoRA+Prune on RoBERTa and 8.2 × \times faster on T5. The declaration checks each speedup with a numeric_constraint property: the ratio of two training-time cells must round to the stated value at one decimal place. For RoBERTa, the cells 5 , 128.3 5,128.3 and 592.1 592.1 bound the ratio to [ 8.660 , 8.662 ] [8.660,8.662] within their printed precision, outside the band [ 8.35 , 8.45 ] [8.35,8.45] that a stated 8.4 permits. paragraphs.en: The record holds every input of the check: the declaration and its provenance, the relation’s kind, version, and source digest, the claim’s statement, and each bound measurement with its value, printed precision, and source line. aratest replay recomputes each verdict from the record alone and prints the recorded and recomputed outcomes together. We moved the ARA out of the working directory before replaying, so the replay read no evidence file. The witness in the record thus reproduces the violation, as Proposition 3.1 states. Replay warns when the relation’s source has changed since the record was saved, and it stops when the relation’s version has changed.
paragraphs.zh: 该记录保存了检查的每一项输入：声明及其来源、关系的种类、版本和源摘要、论断的陈述，以及每个绑定的测量及其值、打印精度和源行。aratest 重放仅根据记录重新计算每个判定，并同时打印记录的与重新计算的结果。 我们在重放之前把 ARA 移出了工作目录，因此重放没有读取任何证据文件。 因此，记录中的见证再现了该违反，正如命题 3.1 所述。 当关系的源自记录保存以来已发生变化时，重放会发出警告；当关系的版本已发生变化时，重放会停止。

paragraphs.en: Reported evidence cannot test behavior that the authors did not measure. For such a claim, a user binds experiment families in the same spec ( Figure 9 ). We show the declaration of MMD-FUSE claim C12 from our campaign ( Section 5.1 ). Its invariant property requires the mean rejection rate over seeds to stay in [ 0.13 , 0.23 ] [0.13,0.23] , a band that we chose for the study, and requires a label-permutation control to lower the rate by at least 0.05. The families block binds seed_resampling , which varies only the jax_seed stream, and asks the agent to run the control.
paragraphs.zh: 报告的证据无法检验作者未测量的行为。 对于这类声明，用户在同一 spec 中绑定实验族（Figure 9）。 我们展示了来自我们研究活动（第 5.1 节）的 MMD-FUSE 声明 C12 的声明。 其不变性属性要求种子上的平均拒绝率保持在 [ 0.13 , 0.23 ] [0.13,0.23] 内，这是为该研究选择的一个区间，并要求标签置换对照将拒绝率至少降低 0.05。 families 块绑定了仅改变 jax_seed 流的 seed_resampling，并要求智能体运行该对照。

paragraphs.en: aratest test runs no experiment. It reports the invariant property as no verdict (missing_evidence) , because the property needs cases of type aratest.run-batch , and exits with code 4. With DissClaimer installed, aratest continuous start runs the bound families as a campaign. Its options name the agent, here DissClaimer ’s openhands , a budget for each run, and a budget for the campaign. For each binding, the service dispatches the experiment-generator agent ( Figure 5 ) and checks the property on the batch that the agent returns. aratest continuous status reports the budget spent and the runs by status, and aratest continuous findings lists each violation with its record and the aratest replay command that rechecks it without DissClaimer . We do not reproduce campaign output here; we report our campaign’s batches in Table 11 .
paragraphs.zh: aratest test 运行时不执行任何实验。 它将该不变式属性报告为无判定（missing_evidence），因为该属性需要类型为 aratest.run-batch 的用例，并以退出码 4 结束。 安装 DissClaimer 后，aratest continuous start 会以战役（campaign）方式运行绑定的家族。 其选项用于指定智能体，这里是 DissClaimer 的 openhands，以及每次运行（run）的预算和整个战役的预算。 对于每个绑定，该服务会分派实验生成器智能体（图 5），并在该智能体返回的批次上检查属性。aratest continuous status 报告已消耗的预算以及按状态分类的运行情况，aratest continuous findings 列出每条违规及其记录，以及无需 DissClaimer 即可重新检查该违规的 aratest replay 命令。 我们在此不复现战役输出；我们在表 11 中报告我们战役的批次。

paragraphs.en: ARATest loads its relations, experiment families, agents, and commands from Python entry points, so a user extends it by installing a package rather than editing ARATest . In Figure 10 , we define a family that reruns training under several seeds. A family is data: an instruction for the agent, a parameters model that a binding fills, and the case model that the agent’s report must match. ExperimentFamily.define derives JSON schemas for the parameters and the cases from the two Pydantic models. The package registers SCORE_SEEDS under the aratest.families entry-point group in its pyproject.toml , and a spec can then bind score_seeds as in Figure 9 .
paragraphs.zh: ARATest 从 Python 入口点加载其关系、实验族、智能体和命令，因此用户通过安装软件包来扩展它，而不是编辑 ARATest。 在图 10 中，我们定义了一个在多个随机种子下重新运行训练的族。 族是数据：一条给智能体的指令、一个由绑定填充的参数模型，以及智能体的报告必须匹配的用例模型。 ExperimentFamily.define 从这两个 Pydantic 模型派生出参数和用例的 JSON 模式。 该软件包在其 pyproject.toml 的 aratest.families 入口点组下注册 SCORE_SEEDS，然后规约就可以如图 9 那样绑定 score_seeds。

paragraphs.en: A new relation registers under aratest.relations . It declares a domain model, which validates a declaration’s fields, and a case model, and it implements four methods. bind resolves what the relation needs from the artifact, observe reads one case, fold decides from all observations, and refine labels the decision. Because bind records a digest of the relation’s source, replay detects a relation that changed after a record was saved. Until a package registers a relation for a Kind , ARATest leaves claims of that kind untested ( Section 3.2 ). An agent registers under aratest.agents , as DissClaimer registers its OpenHands agent under the name openhands . A package can also add a top-level command under aratest.commands , and DissClaimer adds aratest continuous this way.
paragraphs.zh: 一个新的关系会在 aratest.relations 下注册。 它声明了一个用于校验声明字段的领域模型和一个案例模型，并实现四个方法：bind 从工件中解析关系所需的内容，observe 读取一个案例，fold 根据所有观察结果做出决策，refine 为该决策打上标签。 由于 bind 会记录关系源代码的摘要，回放能够检测出在记录保存之后发生变更的关系。 在某个包为一种 Kind 注册关系之前，ARATest 会将该类型的声明保持为未测试状态（第 3.2 节）。 一个智能体会在 aratest.agents 下注册，例如 DissClaimer 将其 OpenHands 智能体以 openhands 这个名称注册。 一个包还可以在 aratest.commands 下添加顶层命令，DissClaimer 就是通过这种方式添加 aratest continuous 命令的。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ARATest on three questions: declaration fidelity on artifacts (RQ1), seeded-fault detection on common evidence (RQ2), and scope-preserving experiments on author code (RQ3).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个问题上评估 ARATest：工件上的声明保真度（RQ1）、常见证据上的植入缺陷检测（RQ2），以及作者代码上的范围保持实验（RQ3）。

paragraphs.en: Every subject enters ARATest as an ARA artifact. We drew the subjects from the ARA-PaperBench corpus [ 33 , 45 ] , which holds 33 ARA artifacts: 23 from PaperBench papers, five from RE-Bench tasks [ 50 ] , one from the NanoGPT speedrun, three from other papers, and our MMD-FUSE artifact. We compiled the two subjects of the reviewed RQ3 tests, MMD-FUSE and Simformer, from their papers and released code with the compiler skill ( Table 4 ). We run two groups of experiments, one for each testing mode ( Section 3 ). The main coverage and detection experiments (RQ1 and RQ2) evaluate integration testing on reported evidence; apart from the author CPU helpers that RQ1 and RQ2 compare against references, they execute no author code. The extended experiments (RQ3) evaluate continuous testing on author code, which the DissClaimer plugin runs.
paragraphs.zh: 每个被测对象都以 ARA 工件的形式进入 ARATest。 我们从 ARA-PaperBench 语料库 [33, 45] 中选取被测对象，该语料库包含 33 个 ARA 工件：23 个来自 PaperBench 论文，5 个来自 RE-Bench 任务 [50]，1 个来自 NanoGPT speedrun，3 个来自其他论文，以及我们的 MMD-FUSE 工件。 我们利用编译技能，从论文和公开发布的代码中编译出经审核的 RQ3 测试的两个被测对象：MMD-FUSE 和 Simformer（表 4）。 我们运行两组实验，分别对应两种测试模式（第 3 节）。 主要的覆盖率和缺陷检出实验（RQ1 和 RQ2）评估基于报告证据的集成测试；除了 RQ1 和 RQ2 用于与参考结果对比的作者提供的 CPU 辅助程序外，它们不执行任何作者代码。 扩展实验（RQ3）评估由 DissClaimer 插件运行的、针对作者代码的持续测试。

sents.en: Every subject enters ARATest as an ARA artifact.
sents.zh: 每个被测对象都以 ARA 工件的形式进入 ARATest。

sents.en: We drew the subjects from the ARA-PaperBench corpus [ 33 , 45 ] , which holds 33 ARA artifacts: 23 from PaperBench papers, five from RE-Bench tasks [ 50 ] , one from the NanoGPT speedrun, three from other papers, and our MMD-FUSE artifact.

sents.en: We compiled the two subjects of the reviewed RQ3 tests, MMD-FUSE and Simformer, from their papers and released code with the compiler skill ( Table 4 ).
sents.zh: 我们利用编译技能，从论文和公开发布的代码中编译出经审核的 RQ3 测试的两个被测对象：MMD-FUSE 和 Simformer（表 4）。

sents.en: We run two groups of experiments, one for each testing mode ( Section 3 ).
sents.zh: 我们运行两组实验，分别对应两种测试模式（第 3 节）。

sents.en: The main coverage and detection experiments (RQ1 and RQ2) evaluate integration testing on reported evidence; apart from the author CPU helpers that RQ1 and RQ2 compare against references, they execute no author code.
sents.zh: 主要的覆盖率和缺陷检出实验（RQ1 和 RQ2）评估基于报告证据的集成测试；除了 RQ1 和 RQ2 用于与参考结果对比的作者提供的 CPU 辅助程序外，它们不执行任何作者代码。

sents.en: The extended experiments (RQ3) evaluate continuous testing on author code, which the DissClaimer plugin runs.
sents.zh: 扩展实验（RQ3）评估由 DissClaimer 插件运行的、针对作者代码的持续测试。

paragraphs.en: For RQ1, we studied all 243 claims in the 33 artifacts after withholding existing declarations. An agent, Codex with gpt-6-astra , declared each claim or recorded why it skipped the claim, under the protocol of Section 3.3 . We kept source bytes fixed within each comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 对于RQ1，在隐藏已有声明之后，我们研究了33个制品中的全部243条声明。 一个智能体（使用gpt-6-astra的Codex）按照第3.3节的协议，对每条声明进行了判定，或记录了跳过该声明的原因。 我们在每次比较中保持源代码字节不变。

sents.en: For RQ1, we studied all 243 claims in the 33 artifacts after withholding existing declarations.
sents.zh: 对于RQ1，在隐藏已有声明之后，我们研究了33个制品中的全部243条声明。

sents.en: An agent, Codex with gpt-6-astra , declared each claim or recorded why it skipped the claim, under the protocol of Section 3.3 .
sents.zh: 一个智能体（使用gpt-6-astra的Codex）按照第3.3节的协议，对每条声明进行了判定，或记录了跳过该声明的原因。

sents.zh: 我们在每次比较中保持源代码字节不变。

paragraphs.en: For RQ2, we seeded faults into SEMA and CFG. Four mutation operators reverse or degrade the claimed comparison. A value swap exchanges the treatment and baseline cells, a single-coordinate counterexample moves one cell by one displayed unit, and two shift operators move the baseline or the treatment past the flip point by k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 5 , 10 } k\in\{1,2,5,10\} displayed units or by the whole pristine margin. We kept a mutant only if mechanical checks confirmed that exactly the intended cells changed and the claim’s truth value flipped. This yielded 553 mutants. Automated review judged all 553 semantically valid and labeled 491 of them plausible ( Section 5.5 ). We exposed 193 mutants during development and held out the 360 shift mutants at k ∈ { 2 , 5 , 10 } k\in\{2,5,10\} and the whole-margin setting, so the holdout is over mutations, not papers. We paired each mutant with its unedited original and added 18 narrower census controls that no operator edited. Before any method predicted, a separate validator labeled every comparison with exact rational arithmetic against the full declared property: six clauses of six comparisons for SEMA and eight clauses of three for CFG. The validator counts a fault as exposed only when a comparison that the mutation affects passes in the original and fails after the mutation; all 553 faults are exposed. The 553 mutants, their 553 originals, and the 18 controls form 1 , 124 1,124 records. We gave each checking method one packet per record; a packet holds the property and the observations to check. Because records with identical inputs share a packet, the 1 , 124 1,124 records collapse to 504 packets: 485 violate the property and 19 hold. The 19 holding packets are the valid controls. The 265 originals that already violate another required comparison share one violated packet and so are not controls.
paragraphs.zh: 对于研究问题二（RQ2），我们向 SEMA 和 CFG 中注入了故障。 四个变异算子用于反转或削弱所声称的比较结论。 数值交换算子交换处理组与基线单元格，单坐标反例算子将某个单元格移动一个显示单位，两个偏移算子则将基线或处理组移动 k ∈ {1, 2, 5, 10} 个显示单位越过翻转点，或移动整个原始余量。 只有当机械检查确认恰好只有预期的单元格发生变化且命题的真值发生翻转时，我们才保留该变异体。 这样共得到 553 个变异体。 自动评审判定全部 553 个变异体在语义上有效，并将其中 491 个标记为合理（见第 5.5 节）。 我们在开发阶段暴露了 193 个变异体，并保留了 k ∈ {2, 5, 10} 及整个余量设置下的 360 个偏移变异体，因此保留集是对变异而非对论文进行划分。 我们将每个变异体与其未编辑的原始版本配对，并加入 18 个未被任何算子编辑的更窄的普查控制项。 在任何方法进行预测之前，一个独立的验证器使用精确的有理数算术，针对完整声明属性对每个比较进行标注：SEMA 为六个比较中的六个子句，CFG 为三个比较中的八个子句。 验证器只有在受变异影响的比较在原始版本中通过而在变异后失败时，才判定该故障被暴露；全部 553 个故障均被暴露。 553 个变异体、它们的 553 个原始版本以及 18 个控制项共构成 1,124 条记录。 我们为每个检查方法针对每条记录提供一个数据包；数据包包含待检查的属性和观测结果。 由于输入相同的记录共享一个数据包，1,124 条记录归并为 504 个数据包：其中 485 个违反属性，19 个满足属性。 这 19 个满足属性的数据包即为有效控制项。 已违反另一所需比较的 265 个原始版本共享同一个被违反的数据包，因此不作为控制项。

paragraphs.en: We also seeded faults into author code. We altered the cumulative-scan helper of the RE-Bench Triton artifact in three ways: the positive test x > 0 became x >= 0 or x > 1 , or the parity test was inverted. An equivalent predicate, 0 < x , served as a control. A network-isolated sandbox ran the original, the three variants, and the equivalent twice each on the 12 registered inputs that RQ1 uses for this helper ( Section 5.2 ). Its 120 evaluations form four packets, each checked by a sampled agreement property over 61 comparisons with a separate sequential reference. The three variants violate it, and the shared original-and-equivalent packet is inconclusive , because agreement on sampled inputs cannot establish correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将故障注入到作者代码中。 我们以三种方式修改了 RE-Bench Triton 工件中的累积扫描辅助函数：将正向测试 x > 0 改为 x >= 0 或 x > 1，或将奇偶校验测试反转。 一个等价的谓词 0 < x 作为对照。 一个网络隔离的沙箱对该原始版本、三个变体以及等价版本各运行两次，测试对象是 RQ1 用于该辅助函数的 12 个已注册输入（第 5.2 节）。 其 120 次评估构成四个数据包，每个数据包通过与一个独立的顺序参考进行 61 次比较、依据抽样一致性性质进行检验。 三个变体违反了该性质，而共享的原始版本与等价版本数据包结果不确定，因为在抽样输入上的一致性无法确立正确性。

paragraphs.en: We compare the deterministic checker with a direct LLM judge and a calculator-assisted LLM judge. All three receive the same packet ( Table 5 ): the plain-language property, its structured clauses, and the observations with comparison identities, units, uncertainty, and completeness limits. Recorded packets also carry the raw table and claim text. Fault labels, mutation locations, and reference verdicts stay hidden. The deterministic checker applies ARATest ’s relations once. Both LLM judges use gpt-6-luna with medium reasoning effort and provider sampling defaults, under a 20 , 480 20,480 -byte input limit for recorded packets and 1 , 536 1,536 output tokens per request. The calculator-assisted judge may also call an exact rational-arithmetic tool, but it cannot run code, read files, or invoke the checker. We score only the first of each judge’s five fresh-context trajectories and keep a failed first trajectory in the denominator. A method detects a fault when it declares a violation and cites a valid witness: a comparison that the fault affects, with correct operands, arithmetic, and clause. Citing a different defect does not detect the injected fault.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将确定性检查器与直接 LLM 评审以及借助计算器的 LLM 评审进行比较。 三者接收相同的数据包（表 5）：以自然语言表述的性质、其结构化子句，以及带有比较恒等式、单位、不确定性和完整性限制的观测值。 已记录的数据包还包含原始表格与断言文本。 故障标签、变异位置和参考判定保持隐藏。 确定性检查器应用一次 ARATest 的关系。 两个 LLM 评审均使用 gpt-6-luna，推理强度设为中等，并采用提供商的默认采样设置，在已记录数据包 20,480 字节的输入限制和每次请求 1,536 个输出 token 的限制下运行。 借助计算器的评审还可以调用一个精确的有理数算术工具，但它不能运行代码、读取文件或调用检查器。 我们仅对每个评审的五条全新上下文轨迹中的第一条进行评分，并将失败的第一条轨迹保留在分母中。 当某种方法宣布存在违反并引用有效见证时，即视为检测到故障：见证是指故障所影响的一次比较，其操作数、算术运算和子句均正确。 引用不同的缺陷不能视为检测到所注入的故障。

paragraphs.en: For each candidate subject, we used the compiler skill to compile an ARA artifact from the paper and its released author code. We kept an artifact only when its author code ran in a pinned container and reproduced a reported value without reading that value. Two of six candidate artifacts qualified: MMD-FUSE [ 5 ] , which measures rejection frequency over repeated two-sample tests, and Simformer [ 18 ] , which measures classifier two-sample accuracy (C2ST, chance level 0.5 0.5 ). The others missed a frozen interval, required unavailable hardware, exceeded the time limit, or lacked a license grant. Neither subject carries an injected fault, but we saw both during development.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个候选对象，我们使用编译技能（compiler skill）从论文及其作者公开发布的代码编译出 ARA 产物（artifact）。 只有当其作者代码能在固定的（pinned）容器中运行、并在不读取该报告值的情况下复现该报告值时，我们才保留该产物。 六个候选产物中有两个符合条件：MMD-FUSE [ 5 ]，它度量重复双样本检验中的拒绝频率；以及 Simformer [ 18 ]，它度量分类器双样本准确率（C2ST，随机水平为 0.5 0.5）。 其余的产物或缺少冻结区间（frozen interval），或需要不可用的硬件，或超出时限，或缺少许可证授权。 这两个对象都不包含注入的故障，但我们在开发过程中两者都见到过。

paragraphs.en: We ran six property-based tests on the unmodified author code. Each test pairs one claim’s property with one auto-research generator, and DissClaimer ’s experiment-generator agent runs the generator’s experiments. The generators instantiate all four family types on MMD-FUSE, and only SeedResampling and OrderPermutation on Simformer ( Table 10 ). The MMD-FUSE seed and row-order tests share one property and differ only in their generator. Neither artifact records a generator binding, so we supplied the binding in place of the research agent. A fresh-context AI reviewer checked each design after the experiment-generator agent produced it and before we froze its target quantity, interventions, controls, and decision rule. We also evaluated one paired reported/fresh property on MMD-FUSE’s released implementations, separately from the six tests.

paragraphs.en: Each run executed in a Docker image pinned by digest under a one-hour limit on one 80-core Linux server. MMD-FUSE tests received 8 CPU cores and 16 GiB 16\text{\,}\mathrm{GiB} of memory; Simformer tests received 4 cores, 32 GiB 32\text{\,}\mathrm{GiB} , and one NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000. We tested the generative catalog only on synthetic data with known noise scale σ \sigma and decision band h = max ⁡ ( 0.05 , 3 ​ σ ) h=\max(0.05,3\sigma) , so the real-code tests used their own registered uncertainty rules.
paragraphs.zh: 每次运行均在由摘要固定的 Docker 镜像中执行，运行于单台 80 核 Linux 服务器上，时限为一小时。 MMD-FUSE 测试分配了 8 个 CPU 核心和 16\text{\,}\mathrm{GiB} 内存；Simformer 测试分配了 4 个核心、32\text{\,}\mathrm{GiB} 内存以及一块 NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000。 我们仅在噪声尺度 σ \sigma 已知且判定带宽 h = max ⁡ ( 0.05 , 3 ​ σ ) h=\max(0.05,3\sigma) 的合成数据上测试了生成式目录，因此真实代码测试使用其各自注册的不确定性规则。

paragraphs.en: We then ran DissClaimer ’s continuous testing service without human review. We screened six candidate targets from the RQ1 corpus and admitted three targets whose unchanged author code and data we could obtain and whose runs fit on one server: MMD-FUSE claim C12, PINN [ 39 ] claim C06, and SMM [ 7 ] (three subclaims of claims C03 and C05). The other three lack public author code or need days of ImageNet training or multi-GPU LLaMA-scale pruning per run. An authoring agent on claude-opus-5-5 wrote each declaration under the protocol of Section 3.3 . Before any run, a fresh-context AI reviewer checked each declaration against its source, and the authoring agent revised any declaration that the reviewer rejected. The MMD-FUSE C12 band is our study assertion, not the paper’s. Each target and model pair ran as its own campaign, in which the service dispatched the experiment-generator agent on gpt-6-luna or glm-5.3-flash . Each run received offline package and data caches, plus two Quadro RTX 8000 GPUs and about 20 h 20\text{\,}\mathrm{h} for PINN and SMM, or no GPU and about 2.7 h 2.7\text{\,}\mathrm{h} for MMD-FUSE. A violation would count as a finding only after a fresh-context AI review against the source, a replay with the deterministic checker alone, and a confirmation run with new random draws. We report every batch that the service adopted within the campaign window.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们在没有人工审核的情况下运行了 DissClaimer 的持续测试服务。 我们从 RQ1 语料库中筛选出六个候选目标，并接纳了三个目标：其作者代码和数据未做改动且可获取，且其运行能在单台服务器上完成：MMD-FUSE 的论断 C12、PINN [ 39 ] 的论断 C06，以及 SMM [ 7 ]（论断 C03 和 C05 的三个子论断）。 其余三个目标或缺乏公开的作者代码，或每次运行需要数天的 ImageNet 训练或多 GPU 的 LLaMA 规模剪枝。 一个运行在 claude-opus-5-5 上的撰写智能体按照第 3.3 节的协议撰写每条声明。 在任何运行之前，一个全新上下文的 AI 审核者会将每条声明与其来源进行比对，撰写智能体会修订被审核者拒绝的任何声明。 MMD-FUSE C12 波段是我们的研究论断，而非论文本身的论断。 每个目标与模型的配对作为其独立的战役运行，服务在该战役中派出运行于 gpt-6-luna 或 glm-5.3-flash 上的实验生成器智能体。 每次运行都配有离线的软件包与数据缓存，外加两块 Quadro RTX 8000 GPU 和约 20\text{\,}\mathrm{h}20 小时（用于 PINN 和 SMM），或不使用 GPU 和约 2.7 小时（用于 MMD-FUSE）。 只有在经过针对来源的全新上下文 AI 审核、仅使用确定性检查器的重放，以及采用新随机抽取的确认运行之后，违规才会计入发现。 我们报告服务在战役窗口内采纳的每一个批次。

paragraphs.en: In RQ1, we ask which complete claims an agent can faithfully declare and ARATest can check. We designed the catalog and readers on these 243 claims ( Section 3.4 ), so the RQ1 results bound what the current catalog reaches and do not estimate coverage on new papers. A claim is faithful and bound when the reviewer accepts its whole declaration and every required property binds to evidence. It is decided when that bound declaration holds or is violated. Every rate divides by all 243 claims, including skips.
paragraphs.zh: 在RQ1中，我们探究智能体能够忠实声明且ARATest能够检验哪些完整论断。 我们基于这243条论断设计了目录与读者（第3.4节），因此RQ1的结果限定了当前目录所能覆盖的范围，并不估计对新论文的覆盖率。 当审阅者接受某条论断的完整声明，且每个必需属性都绑定到证据时，该论断即为忠实且有界的。 当该有界声明成立或被违反时，即做出判定。 每个比率都以全部243条论断为分母，包括跳过的论断。

sents.en: In RQ1, we ask which complete claims an agent can faithfully declare and ARATest can check.
sents.zh: 在RQ1中，我们探究智能体能够忠实声明且ARATest能够检验哪些完整论断。

sents.en: We designed the catalog and readers on these 243 claims ( Section 3.4 ), so the RQ1 results bound what the current catalog reaches and do not estimate coverage on new papers.
sents.zh: 我们基于这243条论断设计了目录与读者（第3.4节），因此RQ1的结果限定了当前目录所能覆盖的范围，并不估计对新论文的覆盖率。

sents.zh: 当审阅者接受某条论断的完整声明，且每个必需属性都绑定到证据时，该论断即为忠实且有界的。

sents.en: It is decided when that bound declaration holds or is violated.
sents.zh: 当该有界声明成立或被违反时，即做出判定。

sents.en: Every rate divides by all 243 claims, including skips.
sents.zh: 每个比率都以全部243条论断为分母，包括跳过的论断。

paragraphs.en: Full ARATest bound 54 claims ( 22.2 % 22.2\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) and decided 40 ( 16.5 % 16.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ): 32 held and eight were violated ( Table 6 ). We widened no tolerance to obtain a decision, so 14 bound claims remained inconclusive . Most decisions test a relation over evidence rather than match a restated summary. Only five depend on reported summaries alone (Andes C02 and C03, Venn C01, Triton C05, and chat-RL C05), and excluding them leaves 35 decided claims ( 14.4 % 14.4\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ). Replay of all 187 reported-property records recomputed every decision from its saved observations without mismatch or drift.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 ARATest 绑定了 54 条声明（22.2%），并对其中 40 条（16.5%）做出了判定：32 条成立，8 条被违反（表 6）。 我们没有放宽任何容差以获得判定结果，因此有 14 条绑定的声明仍无定论。 大多数判定检验的是证据之间的关系，而不是匹配一段复述的摘要。 只有五条声明仅依赖于报告的摘要（Andes C02 和 C03、Venn C01、Triton C05 以及 chat-RL C05），排除它们后仍有 35 条已判定的声明（14.4%）。 对全部 187 条报告属性记录的重放，均基于其保存的观测重新计算了每一项判定，且没有出现不一致或偏差。

sents.en: Full ARATest bound 54 claims ( 22.2 % 22.2\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ) and decided 40 ( 16.5 % 16.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\%} ): 32 held and eight were violated ( Table 6 ).
sents.zh: 完整的 ARATest 绑定了 54 条声明（22.2%），并对其中 40 条（16.5%）做出了判定：32 条成立，8 条被违反（表 6）。

sents.en: We widened no tolerance to obtain a decision, so 14 bound claims remained inconclusive .
sents.zh: 我们没有放宽任何容差以获得判定结果，因此有 14 条绑定的声明仍无定论。

sents.en: Replay of all 187 reported-property records recomputed every decision from its saved observations without mismatch or drift.
sents.zh: 对全部 187 条报告属性记录的重放，均基于其保存的观测重新计算了每一项判定，且没有出现不一致或偏差。

paragraphs.en: The relation catalog contributes most of this coverage. We removed the components cumulatively ( Table 6 ). Without source-preserving readers, ARATest bound two fewer claims. Removing source contracts then cost nine more, two of them the RE-Bench claims that the source-format loader binds, and removing numeric skeletons cost 26 more, which left 17 bound claims.
paragraphs.zh: 关系目录贡献了此处大部分的覆盖。 我们以累积的方式逐一移除各组件（表 6）。 若没有保留来源的读取器，ARATest 少绑定了两个断言。 随后移除来源契约又损失了九个，其中两个是由来源格式加载器绑定的 RE-Bench 断言；再移除数值骨架又损失了 26 个，最终只剩 17 个已绑定的断言。

sents.en: The relation catalog contributes most of this coverage.
sents.zh: 关系目录贡献了此处大部分的覆盖。

sents.en: We removed the components cumulatively ( Table 6 ).
sents.zh: 我们以累积的方式逐一移除各组件（表 6）。

sents.en: Without source-preserving readers, ARATest bound two fewer claims.
sents.zh: 若没有保留来源的读取器，ARATest 少绑定了两个断言。

sents.en: Removing source contracts then cost nine more, two of them the RE-Bench claims that the source-format loader binds, and removing numeric skeletons cost 26 more, which left 17 bound claims.

paragraphs.en: With the base catalog alone, missing relations limited coverage more than the agent did. The agent declared only 24 claims, and about half of its 219 skips (111) cited a missing relation, often because the claim asserts a magnitude, such as a 31.3-fold cost reduction, rather than an ordering. Numeric skeletons supply these magnitude checks. Review mattered as much as relations did. Because review requires every substantive number and condition of the claim, it accepted only 18 of the 24 declarations as faithful. Before any check, it had withdrawn five of the other six because they changed their claim, for example by replacing a rounded ratio with an inequality.
paragraphs.zh: 仅使用基础目录时，缺失的关系对覆盖率的限制比智能体更大。 智能体只声明了 24 个主张，其 219 次跳过中约有一半（111 次）援引了缺失的关系，通常是因为该主张断言的是一个量级，例如 31.3 倍的成本削减，而不是一种排序。 数值骨架提供了这些量级检查。 审查与关系同样重要。 由于审查要求核对主张的每一个实质性数字和条件，它在 24 个声明中只接受了 18 个为忠实的。 在任何检查之前，其余六个声明中有五个已被撤回，因为它们修改了自己的主张，例如用不等式替换了一个取整后的比值。

sents.zh: 仅使用基础目录时，缺失的关系对覆盖率的限制比智能体更大。

sents.en: Numeric skeletons supply these magnitude checks.
sents.zh: 数值骨架提供了这些量级检查。

sents.en: Review mattered as much as relations did.
sents.zh: 审查与关系同样重要。

sents.en: Because review requires every substantive number and condition of the claim, it accepted only 18 of the 24 declarations as faithful.
sents.zh: 由于审查要求核对主张的每一个实质性数字和条件，它在 24 个声明中只接受了 18 个为忠实的。

sents.en: Before any check, it had withdrawn five of the other six because they changed their claim, for example by replacing a rounded ratio with an inequality.
sents.zh: 在任何检查之前，其余六个声明中有五个已被撤回，因为它们修改了自己的主张，例如用不等式替换了一个取整后的比值。

paragraphs.en: To determine whether each verdict reflects the source paper or the compiled artifact, we traced the eight violated and 14 inconclusive claims to their source papers ( Table 7 ). For each claim, a fresh-context AI reviewer downloaded the cited, latest, and camera-ready versions, transcribed the source values, and redid the deciding arithmetic. A separate AI agent recomputed the two paper errors below. The triage changes no RQ1 count.
paragraphs.zh: 为了判断每条结论究竟反映的是源论文还是编译产物，我们将 8 条被违反的声明和 14 条不确定的声明追溯到了其对应的源论文（表 7）。 对于每条声明，一名全新上下文的 AI 审稿人下载了被引用版本、最新版本和最终排版（camera-ready）版本，转录源数值，并重新进行了决定性的算术运算。 另一个独立的智能体重新计算了下文中的两处论文错误。 该分诊处理未改变 RQ1 的计数。

sents.en: To determine whether each verdict reflects the source paper or the compiled artifact, we traced the eight violated and 14 inconclusive claims to their source papers ( Table 7 ).
sents.zh: 为了判断每条结论究竟反映的是源论文还是编译产物，我们将 8 条被违反的声明和 14 条不确定的声明追溯到了其对应的源论文（表 7）。

sents.en: For each claim, a fresh-context AI reviewer downloaded the cited, latest, and camera-ready versions, transcribed the source values, and redid the deciding arithmetic.
sents.zh: 对于每条声明，一名全新上下文的 AI 审稿人下载了被引用版本、最新版本和最终排版（camera-ready）版本，转录源数值，并重新进行了决定性的算术运算。

sents.en: A separate AI agent recomputed the two paper errors below.

paragraphs.en: The violations expose defects on both sides of the compilation step. Four trace to the source papers: two numerical errors, for which we found no prior report, and two smaller mismatches, in a table caption and in the NanoGPT speedrun’s released data. [ 54 ] state that APT trains 8.4 × \times faster than its pruning baseline on RoBERTa and 8.2 × \times faster on T5, but the ratios in their Table 2 are 8.66 × \times and 9.33 × \times , and the raw times in their Table 11 give 8.66 × \times and 8.13 × \times . The stated values match the coarser Table 2 of the first arXiv version. [ 28 ] state that centroid proximity weighting gains 3.14 and 0.97 points on AQuA-RAT and SVAMP, but their Table 1 averages to 2.44 and 0.91. The stated values match the averages of the paper’s other method, but for SVAMP only after we recompute one printed gain from its accuracies. After our disclosure, the authors of both papers confirmed these errors. We checked only these numbers, not the papers’ other conclusions. The other four violations come from the compiled artifact. The compiler skill swapped two SEMA columns ( Section 5.3.1 ) and made two hedged claims strict, and Restricted-MLM C11 states the artifact’s own analysis rather than a paper claim.
paragraphs.zh: 这些违规情况暴露了编译步骤两侧的缺陷。 其中四处可追溯到原始论文：两处数值错误（此前未发现相关报告），以及两处较小的不一致，分别出现在一个表格标题和 NanoGPT speedrun 发布的数据中。 [54] 声称 APT 在 RoBERTa 上比其剪枝基线快 8.4 × \times 倍，在 T5 上快 8.2 × \times 倍，但他们表 2 中的比率为 8.66 × \times 和 9.33 × \times，而其表 11 中的原始时间给出 8.66 × \times 和 8.13 × \times。 所声称的数值与第一版 arXiv 版本中较粗略的表 2 相符。 [28] 声称质心邻近加权在 AQuA-RAT 和 SVAMP 上分别提升 3.14 和 0.97 分，但其表 1 的平均值仅为 2.44 和 0.91。 所声称的数值与该论文另一方法的平均值相符，但对于 SVAMP，只有在根据其准确率重新计算一个印出的提升值之后才相符。 在我们披露之后，两篇论文的作者均确认了这些错误。 我们只核查了这些数字，未核查论文的其他结论。 其余四项违规来自编译产物。 编译技能交换了两列 SEMA（第 5.3.1 节），并将两处留有余地的表述改成了绝对的断言，而 Restricted-MLM C11 陈述的是该产物自身的分析而非论文中的说法。

paragraphs.en: The two paper errors show why an executable property catches defects that careful reading misses. In both, a sentence states a number that the paper’s own table contradicts, but the number appears nowhere in the table, so a reader sees no mismatch without redoing the arithmetic. The ARA keeps the sentence and the table apart: Statement holds the sentence, and the evidence that Proof links holds the cells. The declaration turns each stated number into arithmetic over those cells, and the checker evaluates it over the interval that each printed value’s precision allows. For APT, the ratio lies in [ 8.660 , 8.662 ] [8.660,8.662] , outside the band [ 8.35 , 8.45 ] [8.35,8.45] that a stated 8.4 permits. Interval arithmetic thus rules out rounding as the cause of the gap. Because an ARA transcription error could also cause one, the triage checked each cell against the source paper before blaming the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中的两处错误表明，为什么可执行的属性能够捕获仔细阅读所遗漏的缺陷。 在两处错误中，都有一个句子陈述了一个数字，而论文自己的表格却与该数字相矛盾，但该数字并未出现在表格中的任何地方，因此读者若不重新计算算术，就看不到不一致之处。 ARA 将句子和表格分开存放：Statement 保存句子，而 Proof 所链接的证据保存表格中的单元格。 该声明将每个陈述的数字转化为对这些单元格的算术运算，而检查器会在每个印刷数值的精度所允许的区间上对其进行求值。 对于 APT，该比值位于 [ 8.660 , 8.662 ] [8.660,8.662] 之内，超出了陈述的 8.4 所允许的区间 [ 8.35 , 8.45 ] [8.35,8.45]。 因此，区间算术排除了舍入是造成这一差距的原因的可能性。 由于 ARA 的转录错误也可能导致这种差距，所以在归咎于论文之前，分类检查将每个单元格与原始论文进行了核对。
